summary: iter431 — Sign in with Apple: comprehensive backend + frontend testing. All 10 backend pytest cases pass (start redirect params + state persistence, all callback error branches, happy-path new user with monkeypatched verifier, account linking to existing email with same email/no duplicates, EUA gate for new email without eua_version, single-use exchange code + bogus code 401, magic-link regression, /auth/password/flags apple_enabled). All frontend flows pass (buyer button order Apple→Google→email, black Apple button, EUA gate error message, successful redirect to appleid.apple.com with correct client_id/redirect_uri/response_type/scope/response_mode/state/nonce, /signin?apple=error&reason=cancelled shows 'Apple sign-in was cancelled.', community-apple-btn above community-google-btn and disabled until EUA checked, Maker tab regression — no Apple/Google buttons).
critical_code_review_comments: apple_auth.py is clean: 220 LOC, single responsibility, proper async, environment-driven feature flag with 503 fallback, state+nonce persisted to Mongo with TTL check, form_post callback validates state/nonce/aud/iss/exp, one-time login code decouples id_token from redirect URL (good security hygiene).

Account linking via email upsert (_upsert_buyer) is correct — the same email deduplicates Google/magic-link/Apple onto one buyer row. Verified: apple_sub and apple_private_email are additive updates on the existing user_id.
EUA gate correctly enforces first-time acceptance carried through eua_version query param on /start, while existing users on CURRENT_EUA_VERSION pass through without a re-prompt.

Minor consideration (non-blocking): the state doc is deleted via find_one_and_delete BEFORE the EUA/id_token checks — so a legitimate user who lands on invalid_token or eua_required must restart from /signin (cannot retry with same state). This is arguably correct (states are single-use) but worth noting for UX.
test_credentials: Apple happy paths use monkeypatched verify_apple_id_token; no real Apple ID login attempted (impossible in preview since APPLE_REDIRECT_URI is craftersmarket.org prod).
seed_data_creation: Test users are cleaned up (apple-test-*@example.com, apple-test-magic-*@example.com prefixes). No persistent seed data added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Apple sign-in acceptance criteria verified end-to-end. Test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iter431_apple_signin.py can be re-run with: `pytest backend/tests/test_iter431_apple_signin.py -v`. The suite sets APPLE_SERVICE_ID and APPLE_REDIRECT_URI in os.environ before importing routers.apple_auth, so it is self-contained. Frontend regression coverage: buyer button order, EUA gate, cancelled-error surface, Maker tab absence — all pass on preview URL.
